title: Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas I Rio de Janeiro - RJ.
description:
Job description

Nossa história resume bem o que somos: uma combinação entre nosso potencial e a dedicação de quem acredita que limites existem para serem superados.

Sabemos que para ganhar o jogo precisamos dos melhores talentos e estamos aqui para jogar a longo prazo. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que queiram evoluir continuamente e se desafiar a construir algo relevante para nossos clientes.

Foram a ambição e o trabalho dos nossos associados que nos trouxeram até aqui e que continuarão a nos levar adiante. Por isso, buscamos os melhores profissionais, que sejam obcecados por gerar resultados através do time, liderando uma equipe de alta performance.

Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Main responsibilities

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: Responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.
Requirements and skills

Você deve ter os seguintes requisitos:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas;
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI;
  • Conhecimento com sistemas de CFTV;
  • Vivência com SAP.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Rio de Janeiro - RJ .
Additional information

Nossos benefícios:

  • Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Meetups e eventos com muita troca de conhecimento e uma plataforma interna com diversos cursos e treinamentos;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

    2. Ensure all documents are compliant with company policies and accessible to the Legal Director and relevant stakeholders.

Transformar o sistema de Justiça com tecnologia não é um desafio trivial. Por isso, o Jusbrasil se posiciona como uma empresa AI-first, que utiliza IA Generativa, dados massivos e engenharia de ponta para resolver problemas complexos e criar impacto real em escala.

O papel exige uma liderança com sólida bagagem técnica, capaz de alinhar estratégia, direcionar arquitetura e fortalecer a cultura de engenharia de excelência. Buscamos alguém com olhar sistêmico, que entenda profundamente o ciclo de confiabilidade — da infraestrutura à experiência do desenvolvedor — e que consiga transitar entre a visão estratégica e a execução técnica, fomentando colaboração e impacto direto no negócio.

description:
Job Description

Tietoevry Create welcomes talented professionals to join our project and to work as Senior Telco Service Engineer for our respectful client BICS.

Are you ready to make an impact in a global telecom leader with a diverse and innovative product portfolio? BICS is looking for a dedicated Service Engineer to support key international clients across our extensive range of telecom services. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with both technical and commercial teams, ensuring seamless service delivery and building long-term strategic partnerships. You’ll be the primary after-sales contact, managing complex service issues and tailoring operational approaches to meet each customer’s unique needs—all within a dynamic, international environment.

Your Responsibilities
  • Act as the main point of contact for selected key international customers, ensuring seamless service delivery across BICS’ diverse and innovative telecom portfolio.
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships through customized operational interfaces and proactive engagement, working closely with both technical and commercial teams to align on customer needs.
  • Prepare and present monthly performance reports, lead Service Review Meetings, and drive continuous improvement through corrective actions and follow-up.
  • Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) during incidents or escalations, delivering detailed event analyses, corrective action plans, and formal RFO/RCA documentation.
  • Advise customers on process improvements, reporting tools, and new services/products, helping them unlock the full potential of BICS’s global offerings.
  • Share customer feedback internally to promote operational excellence, foster innovation, and support cross-functional collaboration.
  • Develop and maintain operational manuals detailing service processes, planned work procedures, and escalation matrices to ensure consistency and transparency.
Required Skills and Experience
  • Solid background in the Telecom industry, with a strong technical foundation and experience in customer-facing roles.
  • A customer-oriented mindset with strong analytical capabilities, empathy, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Technical knowledge of message flows in Voice, Signalling, and Roaming scenarios, with the ability to translate complex issues into actionable solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are a plus in our global environment.
  • University degree in Telecommunications or equivalent professional experience.
  • Flexibility, accountability, and willingness to travel internationally. Strong crisis management skills are essential.
  • A passion for working in a global, cross-functional setting, collaborating with experts across technical and commercial domains to deliver world-class service.

This role demands a blend of technical proficiency, customer relationship management, and communication skills to ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction.

Additional Information

At Tietoevry, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

As a Financial Analyst, you'll be a core member of the FP&A Team and wider finance team. What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Location

Brazil

Department

Broadcast & Media Operations

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play‑off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027). The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections, and the escalation of risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key Responsibilities
  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the ongoing development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On‑going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast‑related overlay, as well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on‑site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office. Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre‑planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play‑off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.
Your Profile
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast‑paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high‑pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high‑quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy.   • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity.

Job Purpose: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products into commissioning and field operation.

We are seeking Senior Embedded Hardware Developers with expertise in embedded systems and hardware design to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description
  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system architects, SW architects, product owners
  • Design and develop embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, electronic sub-assemblies.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop embedded hardware products.
  • Create test and verification procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom embedded hardware designs.
You Are Meant For This Job If
  • Expertise in digital electronic design including high speed, serial communication interfaces (CAN, RSXXX, I2C, SPI, USB), control, processor, network interface design on SoC platforms.
  • Extended understanding of Central Processing Units, microcontrollers, embedded software and signal processing techniques
  • Advanced knowledge of VHDL and FPGA design and verification methodologies.
  • Experience of LT SPICE, MATLAB, Simulink, Python, and Intel (Altera) Quartus
  • Knowledge of C, C++, assembly language or other embedded software languages
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, network analyzers, communication analyzers, signal generators, and simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Experience in embedded hardware design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to embedded controller design in control system applications.
  • Knowledge and experience of safety and reliability standards including IEC61508
Qualifications
  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • Industrial experience in relevant embedded hardware development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.
What We Offer
  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Somos a maior seguradora independente no segmento de vida e tivemos uma média de crescimento de 27% de faturamento no país nos últimos 10 anos. Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes.

MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS

Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL) . É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil. Com 150 anos de atuação no mundo, a Prudential tem operações nos Estados Unidos, Ásia, Europa e América Latina.

A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório. Conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

SOBRE A POSIÇÃO:

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Liderar a estruturação da disciplina de Design, incluindo Design System, Design Ops, Service Design e cultura de design thinking
  • Mapear e redesenhar jornadas completas (digitais e presenciais), considerando todos os pontos de contato da experiência do cliente
  • Apoiar e influenciar a definição da visão e estratégia de produto, junto aos times de Produto e Tecnologia
  • Facilitar processos de descoberta, ideação, cocriação e validação com clientes e stakeholders internos
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times multifuncionais, traduzindo necessidades e insights em soluções que gerem impacto real
  • Conduzir e/ou apoiar iniciativas de pesquisa com usuários, prototipação e testes de conceito
  • Criar documentação clara e escalável (personas, jornadas, fluxos, protótipos, specs, entre outros)
  • Atuar como agente de transformação, evangelizando o Design como valor estratégico para o negócio

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação superior completa em design, comunicação, tecnologia, engenharia ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento profundo em metodologias como Design Thinking, Agile, Service Blueprint, Double Diamond, Lean UX
  • Habilidade para facilitar workshops, conduzir pesquisas e comunicar insights com clareza
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões de negócio com base em evidências e empatia com o cliente
  • Excelente comunicação verbal, escrita e visual — storytelling é um diferencial importante
  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas como Figma, Miro, Adobe XD, Zeplin, etc.
  • Vivência com times de produto e tecnologia, colaborando com Product Managers e engenheiros para entrega de soluções
  • Inglês avançado (para leitura, escrita e conversação técnica)
Buscamos alguém que tenha experiência em...
  • Sólida experiência em Customer Experience, UX, Service Design e Design Ops
  • Vivência na construção de produtos e serviços digitais e físicos (phygital), com abordagem omnichannel
  • Facilitar testes de usabilidade e testes não moderados com usuários
  • Experiência prática na criação de interfaces digitais

Aqui você tem flexibilidade com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x2). Essa posição será baseada no Rio de Janeiro.

NA PRUDENTIAL, VOCÊ PODE CONTAR COM:
  • Assistência médica e odontológica
  • Vale refeição e vale alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo Prudential
  • Participação nos lucros
  • Previdência privada com 100% de complementaridade
  • Auxílio creche ou babá
  • Programa de compra de ações
  • Auxílio Funeral, incluindo cônjuge, filhos, pais e sogros
  • Plataforma de desenvolvimento
CUIDAMOS TAMBÉM DO SEU BEM-ESTAR:

O Viver Bem é o principal programa de saúde e bem-estar da Prudential, abrangendo as dimensões física, mental e financeira. Nosso objetivo é promover o autocuidado e proporcionar saúde e bem-estar integral aos nossos colaboradores. Os principais serviços oferecidos incluem:

  • Horário flexível
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Fully e Wellhub: Plataformas para você se cuidar por inteiro, que estimula a atividade física, o cuidado com a saúde mental e financeira.
  • Incentivo financeiro às práticas de atividades físicas
  • Espaço Viver Bem: Ambiente projetado para promover a saúde e o bem-estar;
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por Tempo de Casa
  • Viver Bem+: Acesso gratuito a consultas médicas, nutricionista, coach esportivo, acompanhamento a gestantes e atendimento psicológico.
  • Campanha de vacinação nos escritórios
  • Programa de apoio ao colaborador e seus dependentes com aconselhamento financeiro, jurídico e psicológico

title: Digital Product Owner
description:
Join to apply for the Digital Product Owner role at RINA

We’re building our AI Factory, the engine of RINA's digital innovation and we’re looking for 100+ talented professionals from around the world to join us! If you’re a Software Engineer, AI Expert, Cloud Architect, UX/UI Designer, Digital Product Owner, or Innovation Business Owner, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

Mission: We are currently recruiting for Digital Product Owners to join our office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, within the Global Strategic Initiatives Division. You will lead the development and delivery of cutting-edge digital solutions. This role is central to bridging business needs with technical execution.

Please submit your CV in English.

Key Accountabilities

Technical Team Leadership:

  • Supervise and coordinate the work of Cloud Architects, AI Experts, Software Engineers, and UX Designers during all development phases.
  • Evaluate technical team readiness and capabilities before project kickoff.
  • Provide problem-solving support to overcome obstacles encountered by the technical team to ensure smooth progress.

Product Ownership:

  • Own and manage the product backlog, defining and prioritizing features, functionalities, and enhancements based on business value and user impact.
  • Continuously refine and communicate product vision and roadmap in collaboration with stakeholders.

Translation of Business Requirements:

  • Gather, analyze, and translate business goals and user needs into clear, actionable technical specifications for the development team.
  • Serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and the development team.

Agile & DevOps Management:

  • Lead agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and ensure best practices in agile and DevOps are followed.
  • Monitor sprint performance and ensure timely delivery of product increments.

Quality and Architecture Oversight:

  • Ensure the digital solution is built with strong foundations in security, reliability, and scalability.
  • Review technical designs and architectural decisions with the Cloud Architect and development team.

Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination:

  • Manage external technology partners and resources to support internal capabilities.
  • Maintain alignment between external vendors and internal teams to ensure consistency and quality of deliverables.

UX and User-Centered Focus:

  • Collaborate with UX Designers to ensure the digital product delivers intuitive, seamless, and engaging experiences to end users.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience in similar roles.
  • Developer background and familiarity with AI-enabled capabilities, data-driven decision-making, and integration with cloud platforms.
  • Experience leading tech squads in an Agile environment.
  • Ability to drive infrastructure choices and enable tech/digital best-practices spillover.
  • Integrated project management, also in Agile methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus)

Competencies:

  • ADDRESS THE WAY - Have a big picture of different situations and reinterpret it in a perspective way
  • BUILD NETWORK - Forge trust relationships, across departments, and outside the organization
  • CLIENT INTIMACY - Embrace internal and external client needs, expectations, and requirements to ensure maximum satisfaction
  • EARN TRUST - Take everyone's opinion into account and remain open to diversity
  • MAKE EFFECTIVE DECISIONS - Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources, and constraint
  • MANAGE EMOTIONS - Recognise one's and other's emotions and express and regulate one's reactions
  • PIONEER CHANGE - Actively embrace change and benefit from the new circumstances
  • PROMOTE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT - Promote commitment by keeping promises as a Role Model
  • THINK FORWARD - Capitalise on experiences and translate them into action plans for the future

RINA is a multinational company providing a wide range of services in the energy, marine, certification, infrastructure & mobility, industry, research & development sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion.

At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant with the Italian Law n. 68/99.

Responsabilidades do Cargo:

O profissional será responsável por apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de Segurança de Processo do cliente, com foco na condução e revisão de análises de risco em geral. Atuará em temas relacionados a MOCs (Management of Change), estudos de segurança de processo (HAZID, HAZOP, LOPA, SIL, QRA), avaliação de salvaguardas e análises de causa e consequência, garantindo conformidade com normas e padrões da indústria de óleo e gás.

Principais Atividades:

  • Apoiar a revisão e aprovação de MOCs sob o ponto de vista de segurança de processo;
  • Participar de análises de risco qualitativas e quantitativas (HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, etc.);
  • Apoiar a gestão de barreiras e definição de salvaguardas;
  • Atuar junto à equipe de operações e engenharia para identificação e mitigação de riscos;
  • Contribuir com a melhoria contínua de processos e práticas de segurança operacional.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação em Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia de Petróleo, Engenharia de Segurança ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em segurança de processo, preferencialmente no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Conhecimento de normas e metodologias como API, IEC, NORSOK, ISO, etc.;
  • Inglês Avançado;

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Vivência com MOCs e estudos de risco estruturados;
  • Desejável especialização em Engenharia de Segurança de Processo ou similar;
  • Certificações NR34, NR37 (Básica e Avançada), CBSP, HUET.

title: Shopify Specialist (CRO  Klaviyo  Recharge)
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

the Role

We are looking for a Senior Shopify Developer with deep experience building, optimizing, and scaling high-performing Shopify storefronts. In this role, you will work on production-level stores, enhance user experience, implement CRO strategies, and drive measurable improvements in performance and conversions. You will collaborate with marketing, design, and product teams to translate business goals into technical implementations, ensuring that every update is SEO-friendly, mobile-optimized, and aligned with e-commerce best practices.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, understands the entire e-commerce lifecycle, and has hands-on experience with key tools like Klaviyo and Recharge. If you are passionate about creating seamless shopping experiences, improving conversion funnels, and building scalable Shopify solutions, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic and digital-focused team.

Responsibilities
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Shopify stores in production environments.
  • Implement CRO strategies to improve funnel performance and conversions.
  • Ensure SEO best practices across all storefront pages and features.
  • Work with CRM tools like Klaviyo for emails, automations, and segmentation.
  • Integrate and maintain Recharge for subscription-based e-commerce.
  • Diagnose issues, troubleshoot errors and optimize store performance.
  • Collaborate with marketing, design, and product teams on new features.
  • Ensure all changes follow responsive, accessible, and mobile-first principles.
Must have
  • 5+ years of hands‑on Shopify development experience.
  • Strong knowledge of SEO techniques for e‑commerce.
  • Proven experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) .
  • Hands‑on experience with Klaviyo .
  • Familiarity with Recharge (subscriptions).
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving skills.
Nice to have
  • Experience with headless Shopify (Hydrogen, Next.js, etc.).
  • Experience with A/B testing tools (Optimizely, VWO, Google Optimize).
  • Strong understanding of analytics (GA4, Pixel tracking, attribution).
  • Experience with Liquid templates, performance optimization, and theme development.

Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities
  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.
Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications
  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.
Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements
  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Engineer, you will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients. In particular, you’ll be one of the key contributors in improving operational efficiency, building new features while capitalizing on standardized solutions. Working in close collaboration with both business and engineering teams within Carta, we navigate a unique and challenging product space that intersects with multiple domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and various other teams.

The Team You\'ll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.
About You

You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • You have experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Typescript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink (we invite you to check out our very own ink.carta.com)).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • You have an interest in AI/ML technologies and are eager to explore how they can be applied to improve product experiences.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast but recognize when to build for the future.

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creatinginfrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional, and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross-functionallyto challenge the status quo, working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Atuar junto à equipe cirúrgica, se responsabilizando pela organização, quantidade e qualidade do funcionamento do instrumental e de equipamentos a serem utilizados pela equipe cirúrgica, estando atento a controle de reposição e devolução.

Registro ativo no conselho de classe.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior Automation Engineer shall create, verify and qualify engineering solutions for both subsea and topside applications, supporting customer value-driven purpose in the Automation & Controls business in the oil and gas industry, in particular challenging product development environments in accordance with TechnipFMC standards and processes, and also following the best practices according to Lean Product and Process Development frameworks. Secure compliance on safety, quality, performance, and configurability on controls and automation products and system designs of TechnipFMC products according to legislation, industry standards and customer requirements. This role requires staying updated on technological advances, particularly in automation, electronics, communication, power, networking, sensing and robotics. At the senior level, responsibilities include managing customer expectations and ensuring product quality throughout the project's life cycle—from tender to field operations

Job Description
  • Work cross functionally with product engineers, architecture engineers, system engineers and software engineers to ensure products meet controls and automation business success criteria.
  • Collaborate with other engineering areas at TechnipFMC, as well with the whole value stream representative areas at Controls and Automation department during project execution, to guarantee an integrated solution that meets the system and product life cycle requirements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Responsible for selection of design concepts, development platforms, development tools, component families and design methodologies for relevant scope in controls and automation integrated with system solutions.
  • Conduct project development tasks for the hardware development activities in accordance with industrial standards and main business requirements, performing detailed design and conducting functional verification.
  • Perform technical review of design concepts and conduct product development main tasks according to TechnipFMC standards and process.
  • Participate in communications with internal and external customers when relevant.
  • Conduct feasibility studies for development of new products and systems
  • Establish component, product and subsystem specifications
  • Utilize state-of-the-art technology, methodology and know-how to achieve cost optimum designs with high quality and performance.
  • Execute qualification programs on components, product and system level including functional, environmental, system operation mode.
  • Maintain developer competence and obtain relevant new competence required for new development projects.
  • Familiarize with relevant standards for subsea control systems.
  • Mentor team in development technologies, tools, and processes
You are meant for this job if:
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher within Electronic, Controls & Automation, Mechatronics, or equivalent Engineering, with focus on industrial process control
  • Active CREA
  • Strong technical skills in developing automated applications or research that involved controls process automation
  • Strong technical skills in engineering solution provider on product development processes
  • Good presentation and coaching skills
  • Advanced organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Understanding customer requirements and ability to translate them into product specifications
  • Excellent command of English
  • Experience within configuration and design of industrial control systems on the hardware.
  • Understand dynamics within linear and non-linear systems in general, but upstream oil and gas processes in special.
  • Release project documentation according to International Standards and Customer requirements and present it for customer approval.
Skills
  • Project Management
  • Communication
Inclusion and Equal Opportunity Statement

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes equal opportunities and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matter and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Buscamos Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore para uma das nossas unidades:

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Reportar imediatamente ao Gerente da unidade qualquer risco real ou potencial observado durante a execução de qualquer atividade, paralisando o serviço caso o risco seja iminente.
  • Treinar, orientar e compor o time de resposta a emergência da unidade nas ações específicas de resposta, organizando e participando dos exercícios e simulados de emergência.
  • Realizar palestras e treinamentos de segurança e meio ambiente conforme demanda.
  • Coordenar e apoiar o Gerente da unidade e demais departamentos nas ações referentes às políticas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.
  • Disseminar a cultura de segurança, através de ações para promover a segurança entre nossos colaboradores, com o objetivo de difundir os princípios de segurança e fundamentos de segurança de processo.
  • Coordenar as auditorias de Permissões de trabalho e inspeções nos equipamentos e sistemas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar o atendimento à Matriz de Treinamento da equipe de bordo.
  • Assegurar que a equipe de técnicos de segurança seja treinada e capacitada na aplicação das ferramentas de gestão tais como Greendocs, procedimentos, sistema de PT digital, cartão de observação, registros de incidentes, inspeções rotineiras, listas de verificações, análises de riscos, permissões de trabalho, entre outros, por meio de treinamentos internos definidos nos procedimentos estabelecidos pela organização.
  • Contribuir e ser o facilitador nas investigações de acidentes/incidentes junto à operação, propondo ações de melhorias por meio de técnicas de análises eficazes que garantam a redução e/ou eliminação dos eventos indesejáveis.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico)

  • Formação técnica de Segurança do Trabalho.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória

  • Sólida experiência como Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore e com liderança de times.
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, queremos saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer II
description:
15 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

At Fresenius Medical Care, we’re dedicated to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease through innovative, high-quality products and treatments. Our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—guides everything we do. With over 125,000 people working across 3,700 dialysis centers and 39 manufacturing sites worldwide, we provide direct patient care through our Care Delivery network, develop and supply medical products, therapies, digital solutions via Care Enablement, and accelerate transformation through our FME Reignite strategy. Our values drive us: We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities. We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together. And we Commit to doing things the right way, growing with purpose, and leading kidney care with innovation and compassion.

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic, culturally agile, and results-driven Managing Director Cluster North (Care Enablement) to head our operations across the Latin America North Cluster (Colombia, Peru, Ecuador and Caricam). This leader will be responsible for driving regional growth, strengthening stakeholder relationships, and ensuring operational alignment with global objectives while adapting to the unique dynamics of each local market. The role includes direct leadership of the commercial and marketing teams across the cluster, as well as oversight of any additional functions required to support the business in the region.

This position will be based in Colombia, Ecuador, or Peru, determined by candidate location and business needs. Relocation assistance will be provided as necessary to facilitate a smooth transition.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and execute regional strategies that reflect the economic, and regulatory diversity of the North LATAM markets.
  • Full accountability for P&L, budgeting, and resource allocation across all countries in the cluster.
  • Lead business planning by shaping annual/long-term plans, forecasting KPIs, and building business cases with financial/resource estimates.

No Grupo OLX entendemos que desenvolvimento de software vai além de programação. Buscamos por pessoas que sejam apaixonadas por tecnologia e entendam a importância de usarmos boas práticas (Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura, Algoritmos, Cultura ágil, etc.) no desenvolvimento de um produto.

Pode ser um diferencial/desejável:

  • Atuação em projetos de alta escalabilidade, com milhares de usuários ativos;

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

·Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).

·Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.

·Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.

O Instrutor de Well Control é responsável por ministrar treinamentos de Controle de Poço de acordo com os padrões do IADC Well Sharp (níveis Introdutório, Driller e Supervisor – Superfície e Subsea).   • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.

  • Certificação: Instrutor aprovado pelo IADC WellSharp para ministrar cursos de Controle de Poço

  • Conhecimento Técnico: - Métodos de controle de poço (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) - Pressões de formação, influxo, hidráulica de poço, operações de cimentação e revestimento - Normas e boas práticas internacionais (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

title: Maritime Sales/Account Manager Brazil, Kuiper Mobility BU
description:
Overview

Project Kuiper is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Kuiper is seeking an experienced, self-motivated Sales Professional to lead the adoption of Amazon Kuiper broadband and related services with maritime and offshore partners and end users in Brazil. This role is a unique opportunity to build and execute our sales pipeline with major offshore operators, service contractors, and merchant marine customers. The ideal candidate has a strong track record in selling to, managing, and supporting large Energy sector clients, with maritime experience preferred. Knowledge of agriculture, OEM, and aviation industries is a plus. A solid understanding of satellite communications, experience working with global remote teams, and the ability to manage complex, long-term deals from start to finish are essential. You will be responsible for growing maritime and mobility opportunities in Brazil, managing both direct and channel engagements. This includes working with local partners to establish infrastructure that supports high-value contracts and leading cross-functional teams to deliver on customer and partner initiatives. Strong relationship skills and fluency in English and Portuguese are required.

Please note: This role may involve access to information or technology subject to U.S. export control regulations (EAR/ITAR). Employment is contingent on obtaining any necessary licenses or approvals from the U.S. government, based on eligibility under these regulations.

Key job responsibilities
  • Contribute to the build out of Amazon Kuiper service revenue with specific focus on Mobility partners and end users.
  • Be customer obsessed. Think on behalf of the customer and work to meet the customer’s stated and unstated needs and aspirations
  • Execute strategic and tactical business development initiatives while working with key internal stakeholders (e.g., Amazon Kuiper product and engineering teams, legal, finance) and BD team colleagues.
  • Be the internal coordinator supporting complex contract negotiations and complex business requirements and activities which deliver results.
  • Adept at thinking strategically and analytically about business priorities, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to deliver target based results working cross-organizationally.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications including a passion for writing detailed strategic documents and a preference for a second fluent spoken language.
  • Consistently exceeds key performance metrics and delivers results.
  • Experience driving consensus across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must be able to articulate business value & technical approach.
A day in the life

Kuiper's Sales strategy and Go To Market plan is well defined and yet each working day is different from the next. The satellite Mobility sector is global and our customer engagements take us around the world whether on video calls on supporting face to face engagements. We may start the day with a customer call with Australia and finish the day with a channel partner meeting in Austin. Taking time during a busy day to evaluate critical data points and develop strategies and tactics is important. As is the process of codifying these decisions and their outcomes.

About the team

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust. Experience with Oil and Gas customers. Fluent in Portuguese. Bsc or Msc in telecommunications. MBA. Understanding of regulatory landscape and import tax in Brazil.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
